meaning: stk_vs_anc_at_TSB: diff = log2(stk) - log2(anc), within TSB. diff > 0 means HIGHER in stk; diff < 0 means HIGHER in anc.
stp_vs_anc_at_TSB: diff = log2(stp) - log2(anc), within TSB. diff > 0 means HIGHER in stp; diff < 0 means HIGHER in anc.
stp_vs_stk_at_TSB: diff = log2(stp) - log2(stk), within TSB. diff > 0 means HIGHER in stp; diff < 0 means HIGHER in stk.
TSB_vs_SN_at_anc: diff = log2(TSB) - log2(SN), within anc. diff > 0 means HIGHER in TSB; diff < 0 means HIGHER in SN.
TSB_vs_SN_at_stk: diff = log2(TSB) - log2(SN), within stk. diff > 0 means HIGHER in TSB; diff < 0 means HIGHER in SN.
TSB_vs_SN_at_stp: diff = log2(TSB) - log2(SN), within stp. diff > 0 means HIGHER in TSB; diff < 0 means HIGHER in SN.
interaction_stk_vs_anc_at_TSB_vs_SN: difference of differences = (stk - anc in TSB) - (stk - anc in SN). Positive: the stk-vs-anc difference is larger in TSB than in SN.
interaction_stp_vs_anc_at_TSB_vs_SN: difference of differences = (stp - anc in TSB) - (stp - anc in SN). Positive: the stp-vs-anc difference is larger in TSB than in SN.
interaction_stp_vs_stk_at_TSB_vs_SN: difference of differences = (stp - stk in TSB) - (stp - stk in SN). Positive: the stp-vs-stk difference is larger in TSB than in SN.
